name: Surface-following polygon panels
boundary: Authored planar and curved surface adapters; family silhouettes remain local.

name: Real body openings and reveals
boundary: Rectangular apertures in quad cabin faces; curved full-body cutouts remain specialized.

name: Outline-aware glazing assemblies
boundary: Opaque glass by default. Authored faceted pane meshes may be supplied to preserve creases.

name: Door and access-panel assemblies
boundary: Closed leaves and access panels; sliding rails and opening animation remain vehicle-specific.

name: Surface boundary seams and fastener layouts
boundary: Sampled seams and corner fasteners; no automatic arbitrary hole drilling.

name: Fitted vent and louvre panels
boundary: Polygon-clipped fins in metre-scaled domains; bespoke engine intake mouths use ducts.

name: Projected markings and wear masks
boundary: Projected polygons; national symbols and text layouts remain authored.

name: Wheel arches, liners and fender lips
boundary: Convex cut-body strips, arc flares and liners; faceted military arches retain their shape.

name: Chassis, axles and suspension layouts
boundary: Ladder frames and solid axles; independent wishbones retain their distinct suspension.

name: Steps and boarding ladders
boundary: Treads and rung assemblies; unique retractable stairs remain specialized.

name: Handrail and stanchion runs
boundary: Explicit stanchion paths on tankers; optimized ship rail meshes remain specialized.

name: Seating and cockpit furniture
boundary: Parameterized seat construction; cockpit instruments and benches retain their layouts.

name: Hinge, latch and pull-handle sets
boundary: Independent hinge/pull fittings reused by doors and storage lids.

name: Storage-bin and toolbox shells
boundary: Closed top-lid bins/toolboxes; ammunition cans and open baskets remain separate.

name: Segmented armour skirts
boundary: Segmented skirt attachments; reactive blocks and cage armour remain authored.

name: Cargo support and restraint layouts
boundary: Pallet supports and bound-fitting straps; covers stay in VehicleCloth.

name: Windshield wiper assemblies
boundary: Static parked blades and raised arms; no new animation.

name: Routed hoses, ropes and cables
boundary: Static supported routes with optional sag and collars; no rope simulation.

name: Winch and fairlead assemblies
boundary: Compact recovery spool and fairlead; powered crane drums remain specialized.

name: Mounted fuel and pressure vessels
boundary: Oval/cylindrical tankers with dished ends; rectangular and aerodynamic fuel tanks differ.

name: Aircraft landing-gear assemblies
boundary: Oleo legs and torque links on existing parents; complex bogies and door pivots remain authored.

name: Profiled intake and exhaust ducts
boundary: Double-wall loop ducts and recessed engine faces; distinctive nozzle petals remain authored.

name: Station-loft and revolved-profile mesh kernel
boundary: Loft and revolution kernels; no universal silhouette generator.

name: Airfoil and control-surface construction
boundary: Spanwise airfoil sections and metre-scaled control gaps; planforms remain authored.

name: Hardpoint, pylon and launcher mounts
boundary: Pylons and sway-brace mounts; specialized missile rails retain their geometry.

name: Rocket-pod housings and tube banks
boundary: Seven- and nineteen-tube pods; other tube patterns must be explicitly added.

name: Optical sensor and gimbal housings
boundary: Box and spherical optical housings; mast mechanisms remain vehicle-specific.

name: Navigation and marker-light assemblies
boundary: Side navigation housings and optics; beacon timing remains unchanged.

name: Propeller, spinner and blur assembly
boundary: Profiled blades, spinners and blur; existing wheel/rotor registration remains intact.

name: Mooring fitting assemblies
boundary: Cleat and bitts styles with independent dimensions; marine propellers remain separate.
